\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{arrows.meta,positioning}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  >=Stealth,
  stage/.style={
    draw,
    rounded corners=2pt,
    minimum width=2.6cm,
    minimum height=0.8cm,
    font=\scshape
  }
]
  \node[stage] (source) {\textcolor{blue}{S}ource};
  \node[stage,right=1.2cm of source] (parse) {Parse Tree};
  \node[stage,right=1.2cm of parse] (scene) {Scene Graph};
  \draw[->,thick] (source) -- (parse);
  \draw[->,thick] (parse) -- (scene);
  \node[below=4mm of parse] {browser \textsc{render path}};
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
